notes:
Replication values are supplied/derived by primary project authors, extracted without conversion. Table character encoding is cp1252; effect metric glyphs preserved as supplied. N (R) is not assumed to be analytic n.  The supplied description specifically names Lag 3; table values concern the omnibus group-by-lag interaction rather than the Lag-3-only comparison. The final report separately prints t(30) = .34, p = .74 for Lag 3; table test preserved and mismatch flagged.
Source follow-up: Original-only blind validation. Supplied text title, authors, journal and DOI match the assigned published article. Source version: published article supplied by licensed EBSCO PsycInfo service. The requested printed test statistic is retained, without conversion. Analytic N is reconstructed explicitly from the participant accounting, not taken from the unexcluded Table 1 total. Vertical bar in the n quote separates two exact excerpts on successive pages. Unassigned replication and reported_success are placeholders.
